notes: Derived requirement IDs in U1 NFR artifacts use local namespaces (e.g., NFR1.1 local continuity, NFR2.1 explicit states, NFR3.1 performance, NFR4.1 security/privacy, NFR5.1 medical scope). This intentional local numbering differs from inception NFR IDs; each inception NFR below is mapped semantically to the correct derived requirement(s)/artifact coverage. `NFR5.1` is a local medical-scope requirement (not inception NFR5 Performance) and is traced explicitly under `medical_scope_coverage` to FR6/BR1.14.

coverage.target: tech-stack-decisions.md (Platform Android app MVP; Kotlin/Gradle Kotlin DSL/AndroidX baseline)
coverage.note: Inception NFR1 — Platform scope (Android only). Satisfied by Android-only MVP scope and U1 tech-stack baseline; iOS/web out of MVP.

coverage.target: NFR2.1, NFR2.2, NFR2.3, NFR2.4 (local reliability/observability artifact IDs)
coverage.note: Inception NFR2 — Usability/clarity of fallback states. Mapped to typed explicit states/next actions, state consistency (ADR-006 stale semantics), recovery behavior, and user-visible fallback/unknown/stale state contracts.

coverage.target: NFR4.1, NFR4.2, NFR4.3, NFR4.4, NFR4.5, NFR4.6 (local security/privacy artifact IDs)
coverage.note: Inception NFR3 — Privacy and GDPR-aware handling. Mapped to no MealPlanner account, data minimization, optional purpose-limited location, no hardcoded secrets, and privacy-safe minimal diagnostics.

coverage.target: tech-stack-decisions.md (Testing frameworks; Testability/quality gates inception NFR4 baseline)
coverage.note: Inception NFR4 — Testability and quality gates. Explicitly mapped to testability/quality-gates baseline aligned with team posture (key behaviors tested where practical, critical tests/CI checks run, existing tests green, no weakened targets); concrete frameworks/CI confirmed in NFR Design/build-and-test/Code Generation.

coverage.target: NFR3.1, NFR3.2, NFR3.3, NFR3.5 (local performance artifact IDs)
coverage.note: Inception NFR5 — Performance and responsiveness. Mapped to local responsiveness target, bounded external adapters with fallback/non-blocking core flows, first useful local view, and deferred diagnosability/measurement method.

medical_scope_coverage.target: NFR5.1 (local medical-scope requirement; not inception NFR5 Performance), BR1.14
medical_scope_coverage.note: Nutrition/health-related information is view-only and non-medical: no diagnoses, treatment recommendations, or personalized medical dosing. Missing nutrition data labeled `Nutrition information unavailable`. No fabricated data. U1 contracts allow missing nutrition data without blocking core flows (BR1.14).
